What Is Artificial Intelligence (AI)? Types, How It Works, Applications, Benefits and Drawbacks

AI stands for artificial intelligence and it is the technology behind systems that learn from experience, adapt to new information and perform tasks that require human intelligence such as recognizing speech, making decisions or understanding language without explicit instructions for each task. AI systems such as digital assistants and chatbots like Alexa, Siri, ChatGPT or Gemini handle conversations and provide answers on websites without human involvement.
